limitations: Roster identity metadata is reviewer-reported from the exact pinned family-295 roster, not re-read from the author local object store.

Original class remains unknown; physical candidate index is not a class label.

roster_and_contact_limits.roster_record_scope: The nine family-295 roster entries below provide source-feature ordinal/index, name, source ID, roster owner-index metadata, and geometry_status only. Owner indices [7129] are copied roster metadata, not per-key current-owner outcomes.
roster_and_contact_limits.roster_pin: pins.family_roster identifies commit, path, blob, compressed and decoded hashes/sizes; exact roster identities and owner/geometry_status values were reported by independent reviewer from those pinned bytes.
roster_and_contact_limits.membership_scope: The 10×9 matrix records only whether each family-295 source_feature_index appears in that exact cell row run sids list under the pinned source-batch-intervals.mjs contract. Presence is source-raster candidate evidence; absence is only absence from that candidate list.
roster_and_contact_limits.missing_true_contact_evidence: This packet has no exact per-key geometric intersection/contact or point-in-polygon results across all nine family-295 features. The roster geometry_status raw-native-supported is feature-level metadata, and sids presence/absence is raster candidate membership; neither fills that per-key geometry-contact matrix. No geometric contact is inferred from a present or absent sids value.
roster_and_contact_limits.additional_missing_evidence: No lineage join or independent source-applicability/qualification witness is included for these exact original keys.
